content: Context-specificity manifests very differently in ELMo, BERT, and GPT-2. In ELMo, representations of words in the same sentence grow more similar to each other as context-specificity increases in upper layers; in BERT, they become more dissimilar to each other in upper layers but are still more similar than randomly sampled words are on average; in GPT-2, however, words in the same sentence are no more similar to each other than two randomly chosen words.
